review.notes: Seeded sample read in full: 0.1, 3.6, 3.7, 4.5, 5.4, 7.1, 7.8, 9.1, 10.2, 10.10, 10.15, 10.17, 10.19, 14.4, 15.5. Also read: Layers 14-15, 5.3, 6.2, 6.4-6.5, 7.2, and the Scope and supplier contracts. All 359 Checks were read and their values recomputed; two are false (R01 in 6.2, R02 in 12.1). The 3,905 supplier-contract names were checked mechanically against their files; one is misfiled. Sources read: Nolan ch. 1 (author page), R Beta documentation, DLMF 8.17, the Stan LKJ page, the SciPy genextreme page. The handbooks and LKJ 2009 are paywalled. Automatic checks: all passed. depcheck: 0 problems. Elaboration: sorry warnings only. One-tactic probe: map_uniform_quantile closes by one simpa (C01). Overlap: the real Wick-Isserlis formula is also planned by RandomMatrices 2.5 on main (R03).
